name: EmojiPopover
description:
An EmojiPicker in a popover. The picker's code and data load when it first opens; until then
the popover holds the picker's size, so nothing moves.
signature: ({ trigger, open, defaultOpen, onOpenChange, closeOnPick, side, align, anchor, finalFocus, onPick, "aria-label": label, ...picker }: EmojiPopoverProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: align
props.description: Alignment of the overlay relative to its anchor.

props.name: anchor
props.type: Element | import("@floating-ui/dom").VirtualElement | import("react").RefObject<Element | null> | (() => Element | import("@floating-ui/dom").VirtualElement | null) | null | undefined
props.description: Anchor used to position floating content.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the popup. Default "Emoji picker".

props.name: closeOnPick
props.description: Close after a pick. Default true.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether it starts open when uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultSkinTone
props.description: The skin tone at first when uncontrolled. Default 0.

props.name: finalFocus
props.type: boolean | import("react").RefObject<HTMLElement | null> | ((closeType: import("@base-ui/utils/useEnhancedClickHandler").InteractionType) => void | boolean | HTMLElement | null) | undefined
props.description: Where focus returns on close. Default the trigger.

props.name: loadNames
props.description:
Names for the current locale, by emoji without a tone: the name shown and searched, with
any keywords after it. Without this names are English, and a search matches English only.
The application supplies them, so no language's data ships in the library.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with the next open state.

props.name: onPick
props.description: Called with the emoji a person picks by click, Enter or Space.

props.name: onSkinToneChange
props.description: Called with the tone a person chooses.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether it is open, controlled.

props.name: recent
props.description: Emoji to offer first, in a Recent tab. The host keeps this list; without it there is no tab.

props.name: side
props.description: Preferred side of the anchor; collision handling may choose another side.

props.name: skinTone
props.description: The skin tone, controlled: 0 for none, 1 (light) to 5 (dark).

props.name: skinTones
props.description: Offer the skin tone menu. Sequences with two people have no tone. Default true.

props.name: trigger
props.description: The element that opens it, usually a Button. Omit it and pass `anchor` when controlling `open`.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
